summary:
OUR GAME – THE MYSTERIOUS JOURNEY OF MARS 🚀

Our game is an educational space adventure where players explore Mars, answer questions, and complete challenges. With Momo, our space companion, they unlock new levels and discover the mysteries of Mars while having fun.
details:
GAME DETAILS 🚀

Our game includes different question areas, alien encounters, rewards, and helpful robots. Players can complete challenges, earn points, and unlock 8 levels. Momo also changes its appearance as players progress. Every ten levels, players discover a short story about Mars.
